![Azeria Gold, the Flaming Fox (By SrKelvin)](https://neoncitylights.wdfiles.com/local--files/legend:azeria/Azeria-Gold-By-SrKelvin.png)

**Name.** Azeria Gold

**Lineage.** Splicer (Fox)

**Age.** 33

**Height and Weight.** 6'0", 180 lbs

**Pronouns.** she/her

**Classes/Subclasses.** Brawler (Sunset Clan) 20

**Features.** Flaming fists and tattoos that travel up her arms, with orange hair, fox ears and a bushy tail. A glowing nanite infused tattoo linked to her CHI implant in the middle of her chest.

**Status.** Alive

Azeria is a runner who does things the right way. She punches things until they die, more often than not. A good friend of the old-guard of Neon City, the long-standing band of Street Legends, consisting of [Tobi](/legend:tobi), [Katze](/legend:katze), [Ruby Stained Pitch](/legend:rsp), [Natasha](/legend:natasha), [Rose](/legend:rose), and others. She now owns a gym in the lower commons with a more or less 'come in when you need' policy, allowing those less fortunate than herself to better themselves without having to pay for a corporate gym membership.

She isn't quite retired, but is more or less inactive at this current moment, but the right job at the right time might stir her from her slumber, and when she returns, she'll return hotter than ever.

**Player.** @aluereon
